assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production game environment background, existing pixel-art scene cleanup.
Input image is the edit target. Remove ALL human characters and their local cast shadows from this exact scene: the small brown-hatted person at far upper-left beside the café, the straw-hatted person on the upper-right path, the navy-uniformed harbor worker beside the lower-center hut, and the brown-haired brown-jacketed protagonist with khaki shoulder bag on the lower-center stone path. Remove any other people if present. Seamlessly reconstruct ONLY the ground or scenery immediately behind their former silhouettes using the existing stone paving texture.
Preserve the entire environment exactly: original camera, framing, aspect ratio, buildings, café, boat, pier, stone paths, steps, cliffs, water, trees, foliage, benches, railings, every prop, lighting and shadows unrelated to people. This is a precision removal, not a redesign. Maintain the delicate detailed pixel-art edges and original palette. Full original canvas, no crop, no zoom, no new elements, no UI, no text, no characters.

validation.visual_check: All four people removed; original scene composition and dimensions retained. No people visible.
validation.note: Image generation edits retain scene structure visually; not a claim of pixel-identical untouched regions or tested collisions.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG runtime sprite atlas for a detailed 2D pixel-art role-playing game.
Create ONE square 1024 x 1024 PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, containing exactly FOUR full-body idle standing sprites of the SAME human young adult male protagonist, in a strict 2-column by 2-row grid of four identical 512 x 512 cells. No visible grid. Top-left FRONT VIEW facing down toward camera; top-right BACK VIEW facing away; bottom-left LEFT PROFILE facing screen-left; bottom-right RIGHT PROFILE facing screen-right. These are four orthographic cardinal direction idle views, not four poses or three-quarter rotations.
Character: tousled medium brown short hair, rust-brown casual work jacket, muted light undershirt, dark navy trousers, brown sturdy ankle boots, compact khaki canvas crossbody satchel. Strap runs from his right shoulder to his left hip. Same age, face, hairstyle, jacket, clothing colors and consistent bag placement across all four rotations. Human adult, gentle neutral expression, roughly four-heads-tall RPG sprite proportions. No animal ears, no weapon, no hat, no accessories beyond the satchel.
Style: richly detailed hand-crafted pixel art, clean dark pixel outlines, subtle stepped highlights, restrained earthy rust/navy/khaki palette, compatible with a finely textured sunny seaside RPG village and café scene. Light from upper-left. A slight elevated RPG viewing angle consistently across all four directions, showing tops of heads and boot tops. Crisp pixel clusters, not blurry painted cutouts and not smooth vector art.
PRECISE ATLAS LAYOUT IS CRITICAL: all sprites exactly the same scale and height, about 330 pixels tall. Each is horizontally centered at x=256 or x=768. Within each 512-pixel cell the character stands centered horizontally, with the bottom of both boot soles aligned to local y=430. Full head and both feet visible, equal top and side transparent padding, no pixel crosses a cell boundary. Arms relaxed at sides; both feet planted, same stance for all four directions. Keep individual silhouette compact enough to leave at least 100 transparent pixels at either side of every cell. Nothing else in the entire image: no floor, no ground shadows, no scenery, no colored fill, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no decorations. Truly transparent background, not a painted checkerboard.

alignment_edit_attempt.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided transparent sprite atlas ONLY to align the four existing sprites inside its equal grid. Preserve the exact 1254 x 1254 transparent PNG canvas and exact four character designs, outfit, face, hair, bag, pixel-art rendering, and four directions: top-left front, top-right back, bottom-left facing left, bottom-right facing right. Do not redraw them into a different style.
The atlas is exactly 2 columns and 2 rows, each cell 627 x 627. Reposition and, if needed, slightly uniformly scale the existing complete sprites to this precise shared registration:
- local horizontal center of every character body and planted stance is x=313 in its own cell. Global centers x=313 for left column, x=940 for right column.
- bottom of both boot soles / foot anchor is local y=565 in every cell, global y=565 for top row and y=1192 for bottom row.
- visible full-body height is the same 510 pixels in every cell, with tops around local y=55. Profiles may be naturally narrower, but must not be shorter or off-center.
Keep all heads, satchels, hands and both boots completely visible. At least 100 transparent pixels either side of each character. No pixel may touch or cross cell boundaries. Change ONLY placement/scale registration, no added lines, markers, grid, text, shadows, background or extra objects. Preserve REAL transparent alpha, not a checkerboard. Four perfectly aligned atlas frames.
alignment_edit_attempt.reason: The edit did not achieve pixel-exact cell registration; the original has a smaller row-to-row foot-baseline difference.

validation.registration: Requires per-frame anchor compensation in the engine; uniform pixel-perfect pivots were not achieved by image generation. Suggested anchors are alpha-bounds center x and last opaque y, measured with alpha > 127. No runtime integration tested.
validation.faint_alpha_residuals: Some cell-border pixels have nonzero very low alpha; measured maxima are recorded per frame. They are not opaque character pixels.
